Plans at 1 mm = 1 unit (body 290 × 170). Rough: for judging the idea, not the layout. Knob counts indicative.

g.text: signal sentence as five numbered plates; gaps, not lines; one emblem per plate
cells = sections, sized by content; walls = bag armour; slide-in label cards
3 HYMNAL (new: a bound book you carry)
cover = bag protection; opened, it stands as a music desk held by its ribbon, or folds under as a rake
≈ 40 mm thick closed (rim taller than knobs)
spine roll under the back ≈ 14 mm → ≈ 5°
Bookcloth over 3 mm ply boards; title blind-stamped on the spine (letterpress); no recall, so the patch is written in pencil on the endpaper — the Model D patch-book habit made part of the object.
4 HUSH (new: built from the material of silence)
the felt that stops the keys is the skin of the whole; the skin wrapping the lip IS the key's top stop
felt skin on the panel wraps the lip: the key tail rises into it = top stop
Body: rigid tray wrapped in 3–5 mm wool felt.
machine) or laser-browned into the felt.
Bag: a felt flap rolls over panel + keys, closes
with a wooden toggle and loop (chisel-roll logic).
Lap: grips, warm, silent on a table.
Risks: grime/pilling at knobs; felt deadens
the speaker — grille must be an open window.
board = playfield under a clear top, reverse-painted underneath
